name: The Everyday Curl
description: A soft, curly look that brings a little extra personality to everyday outfits and dressed-up plans. Its 18-inch length gives you a defined, face-framing style.

name: Dew Drop Face Cream
description: A simple daily moisturiser for adding a comfortable, hydrated feel to your skincare routine. The 50 ml size fits neatly on your shelf or in your travel bag. Check the product packaging for the full ingredient list and directions.

name: Sunday Kind of Love
description: A 50 ml eau de parfum made for those days when you want your fragrance to feel like part of the outfit. A lovely pick for your own collection or a thoughtful gift.

name: The Main Character
description: A caramel-toned sculpted heel that makes an outfit feel considered, whether you are dressing for an occasion or adding a statement to a simple look.

name: Soft Life Straight
description: A sleek, straight style with a 20-inch length for a polished look. Wear it as your everyday finish or style it up for plans after hours.

name: Sunday Skin Body Butter
description: A 200 ml body butter for adding a little feel-good care to your daily routine. Its whipped texture makes it a lovely treat after a shower or whenever your skin needs a little extra comfort. Check the packaging for ingredients and directions.

name: Soft Spoken
description: A 30 ml warm-amber fragrance that is easy to bring along for a day out or keep close for evening plans. A smaller size for trying a new scent or gifting someone special.

name: The One More Look
description: A cocoa-toned everyday sandal that pairs easily with your casual favourites. A simple go-to for days when you want a comfortable-looking, put-together finish.
